description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is loaded in InVesalius 3. A researcher needs to simulate bone degradation. Create a project containing two segmentation masks: (1) A baseline bone mask using the standard Bone threshold (226 HU to Max), and (2) An 'eroded' mask created by applying the 'Erode' morphological operation to the bone mask (reducing its volume). Save the project to /home/ga/Documents/bone_loss_simulation.inv3. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
